role.altitude: The adapted PE specialist keeps judging compliance and safety, choosing equipment and deciding repairs; tracking plan deadlines, filling order forms, writing up counts and logging loans shrink.
skills_to_grow: Keeping equipment labels and loan scans up to date
role.ambitious_version: A specialist who never finds a support plan overdue or an aid missing at the start of a lesson.

tasks.short: Gather the requirements, check support plan dates and evaluations, observe practice and equipment safety, judge compliance and record the review of adapted physical education programs or practices.

steps.what: Adapted PE specialist gathers the requirements: inspection framework, support plan rules and safety rules
Adapted PE specialist checks each pupil's support plan dates and evaluations
Adapted PE specialist observes practice and checks the safety of equipment and lessons
Adapted PE specialist judges compliance and decides improvements
Adapted PE specialist writes the review notes

tasks.design: The pupil record keeps the legal deadlines for support plans as timers, setting within six weeks and evaluating yearly, and lists plans that are due or overdue, so the specialist does not check each plan by date. Requirements sit in a checklist kept by the school. Observing practice and safety and judging compliance stay with the specialist; review notes use a template.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plan dates were checked by opening each pupil's file.
tasks.enabler_now: Pupil records with deadline timers for support plans.
tasks.still_hard: Practices that meet the rules but do not serve the pupil.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing that an exercise is unsafe for one particular pupil.

evidence.claim: A support plan is set within six weeks of enrolment after consulting parents and evaluated yearly.
A pupil record system has a support plan module and goal tracking.

assumptions: Boundary: reviewing adapted PE practice for compliance; inspection by authorities is outside.
Input contract for s2: plan dates and evaluations entered by the care team in the pupil record.
Observation and judgement keep their full time.
research_questions: Are support plans evaluated on time more often?

incremental.description: Adapted PE specialist keeps the requirements checklist current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: few pupils with support plans; high: special schools where most pupils have one.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Decide what equipment is needed, find products in the contracted catalogue, request or order physical education equipment following standard procedures, have it approved and ordered, and check delivery.

steps.what: Adapted PE specialist decides what physical education equipment is needed
Adapted PE specialist finds products and prices from suppliers
Adapted PE specialist requests the equipment following the standard procedure
School manager approves the final order request
School administrator places the approved order with the supplier
Adapted PE specialist checks the delivered equipment

approvals.approved_version: the order request as approved by the school manager in s4; any change goes back for approval

tasks.design: The school's procurement portal shows the contracted suppliers' catalogues with prices, and the specialist's basket becomes the order request, routed to the school manager for approval instead of a paper form and mail. After approval the administrator places the order. Deciding what is needed and checking delivery stay with the specialist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requests went on paper forms with prices copied from catalogues.
tasks.enabler_now: Procurement portals with contracted catalogues and approval routing.
tasks.still_hard: Specialist aids not in any contracted catalogue.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which aid will work for a particular pupil.

evidence.claim: Spreadsheets and mail are the glue today; records apps with workflows replace them.

assumptions: Boundary: from need to checked delivery; paying invoices is outside.

Input contract for s2: catalogues of contracted suppliers loaded in the portal by the school's purchasing office, covering about 70% of items; specialist aids are quoted separately; s2 is priced at that share.
Deciding and checking delivery keep their full time; manager and administrator time is outside the specialist's savings.
unknowns: Share of specialist aids outside contracts.

incremental.description: Adapted PE specialist asks purchasing to add frequently needed aids to the catalogue.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly specialist aids from small suppliers; high: mostly standard equipment from contracted suppliers.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Count and check equipment, record counts and condition, decide repairs and replacements, and track loans to maintain the inventory of instructional equipment, materials or aids.

steps.what: Adapted PE specialist counts and checks equipment in the storeroom
Adapted PE specialist records counts and condition in the inventory
Adapted PE specialist decides repairs and replacements
Adapted PE specialist tracks loans of aids to pupils and colleagues

tasks.design: Each item or box carries a code label. During the count the specialist scans labels on a tablet list and picks a condition, so counts are recorded as they are made instead of written down and typed later. Loans of aids are scanned out and in, and the list shows what is out and with whom. Deciding repairs and replacements stays with the specialist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counts were written on paper and typed into a spreadsheet; loans were on a paper list.
tasks.enabler_now: Code labels and scanning on a tablet or phone.
tasks.still_hard: Small items that are hard to label.
tasks.human_edge: Spotting wear that makes an aid unsafe.
tasks.altitude: Less writing; checking and deciding stay.

reach.learn: Whether aids are easier to find.

assumptions: Boundary: keeping the inventory; buying is a separate task.
Input contract for s2: counts and condition captured by scanning during s1.
Counting keeps most of its time; deciding repairs keeps its full time.

incremental.description: Adapted PE specialist labels new items.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: small stores counted rarely; high: large stores with many loans.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
